venture_hypothesis: A mobile-first platform that allows freelancers to find high-quality, long-term project work without competing on price. We solve the problem of gig workers facing race-to-the-bottom commoditization by connecting them with companies that value specialized skills and fair compensation.

target_customer.segment: Experienced freelancers and independent consultants earning 60k-150k annually who want stability and premium pricing
needs: Reduced time hunting for new clients
pain_points: Exhaustion from constant pitching and platform competition
Fragmented client base requiring constant relationship building

problem_statement: Independent professionals with proven expertise waste time competing for work on generic freelance platforms, often undercutting themselves, while premium clients struggle to find reliable, skilled talent for meaningful projects.

business_model.revenue_model: Commission on projects (12% from freelancers, 8% from clients)
business_model.customer_acquisition: Content marketing, referral program, direct outreach to top freelancers
business_model.unit_economics: Average project value $15k, 15% take rate = $2250 per project

desired_perception: The trusted platform where serious freelancers and quality-focused brands find each other
constraints: Cannot compete on price with Upwork
Must appeal to both freelancers and brands
